subject: Summer Fridays
method: case-insensitive regular-expression candidate coding over every eligible deduplicated retailer review; direct structured recommendation fields remain direct outcomes; textual choice outcomes attach to an axis only when the outcome and axis occur in the same sentence, or when the review contains exactly one coded axis
ceiling: deterministic high-recall coding for captured-sample incidence; not population prevalence, sentiment scoring, or proof that every implicit mention was recovered

axes.label: Value for price and usable quantity
axes.pattern: \b(overpriced|overprice|expensive|pricey|not worth|worth (?:the|it)|waste of money|save your money|price|too tiny|tiny (?:tube|bottle|jar|size|amount|product)|too small|small size|barely any|little product|amount|quantity|sample size|rip[ -]?off)\b

axes.label: Packaging and dispensing reliability
axes.pattern: \b(packaging|applicator|wand|pump|cap|lid|leak(?:s|ed|ing)?|(?:applicator|tube|pump) (?:clog(?:s|ged|ging)?)|clogged (?:applicator|tube|pump)|bottle broke|tube split|stopped working|stop working|doesn.?t come out|won.?t come out|dried (?:up|out)|empty tube|air[ -]?filled|barely full|tip went in|product stuck)\b

axes.label: Wear time and longevity
axes.pattern: \b(doesn.?t last|didn.?t last|lasts? (?:all day|longer|only|[0-9]+ (?:minute|minutes|hour|hours))|lasted (?:all day|only|[0-9]+ (?:minute|minutes|hour|hours))|long[ -]?wear|wear[ -]?time|longevity|wears? off|(?:color|colour|pigment|scent|fragrance) fades?|fad(?:e|ed) (?:quickly|fast|within)|rub(?:s|bed)? off|wipes? off|slip(?:s|ped)? off|transfers?|reapply|reapplication|staying power|stays? on)\b

axes.label: Coverage and pigment payoff
axes.pattern: \b(coverage|pigment(?:ed|ation)?|sheer|opaque|buildable|color payoff|colour payoff|payoff|barely shows|doesn.?t show|no tint|zero coverage|conceal(?:s|ed|er)?)\b

axes.pattern: \b(shade range|shade|undertone|too warm|too cool|orange|color match|colour match|match(?:ed|es)? my skin|pigment color|pigment colour)\b

axes.label: Formula consistency and change
axes.pattern: \b(new formula|old formula|reformulat(?:e|ed|ion)|formula changed|changed (?:the )?formula|inconsistent|batch issue|bad batch|expired|old product|moldy|mouldy|oxidized|oxidised|separated|separation|watery now)\b
